steps.title: And the logo lookup requests are recorded
steps.expected: One logo lookup for licter.com is visible (request names noted for the other TCs)

results.notes: Executed in full on a fresh wizard (Brand analysis, custom brand "Lictorix Geo" via the "— Custom Brand" row). Given: green 32x32 span lettermark "L", empty field, card 54 px. Typing "licter.com" (120 ms/key): avatar unchanged, 0 lookup requests. On blur: span "h-8 w-8 shrink-0 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-slate-200" 32x32, empty, and "licter.com" under the name at the same time (card 54 -> 61 px for the domain line, avatar stays 32x32). The /brands/logo response was delayed 2.5 s with a Playwright route (test aid only, response unchanged) to capture the transient placeholder in step2_when. Then src https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com&sz=64 (32x32). Network: exactly one GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com -> {"domain":"licter.com"}, then s2/favicons -> t2.gstatic.com faviconV2. Request names: "brands/logo" (lookup) and "s2/favicons" (image).

results.notes: Fresh wizard (full page load). "onclusive.com" typed one character at a time (200 ms/key): 0 lookup requests and no avatar mutation during typing (MutationObserver log: only the initial "L" state until Enter). Enter: step not submitted (still Brand & Country, focus kept in the field); placeholder animate-pulse bg-slate-200 32x32 (captured in step2_when with the 2.5 s route delay test aid), then the onclusive.com image (Google favicon fallback = onclusive.com logo mark, Brandfetch quota exhausted). Network: exactly one GET /brands/logo?domain=onclusive.com, none for partial values; a later blur of the same value sent no second lookup. "onclusive.com" under the brand name.

results.notes: Given: "Lictorix Geo" + "licter.com" confirmed (licter.com favicon image, "licter.com" under the name) + country United States / English (EN) added in the wizard (not saved anywhere). Edit (Ctrl+A, then "onclusive.com" typed char by char): licter.com image and "licter.com" kept while typing, 0 requests. Blur: DOM state log = [licter.com image + "licter.com"] -> [placeholder + "onclusive.com"] -> [onclusive.com image + "onclusive.com"]; no recorded state paired the licter.com image with "onclusive.com". One GET /brands/logo?domain=onclusive.com. Discover Categories -> Categories step ("Geospatial Data Platform", "Location Intelligence Software"); Back -> Brand & Country shows "onclusive.com" with the onclusive.com image, field value "onclusive.com", no new lookup. Visuals are Google favicon fallbacks (Brandfetch quota exhausted). No analysis created.

results.notes: Request blocking for "s2/favicons" done with a Playwright route abort (blockedbyclient), equivalent to DevTools request blocking (test aid). W4 = "example.com": placeholder on blur (step2_when), one GET /brands/logo?domain=example.com -> {"domain":"example.com"}, s2/favicons request aborted, rendered for ~5 ms then replaced by the span lettermark "L" (32x32, white 14px/500 on green). "example.com" under the brand name (TC-GEO-1262-008_card_zoom.png). Same letter-avatar component as the dashboard (identical classes "inline-flex ... h-8 w-8 rounded-full text-sm bg-*-500"; colour is derived from the name, e.g. dashboard "Licter" = red, wizard "Lictorix Geo" = green).
